title: Multi-Worm Test Scenario
description: Schema for multi-agent Dolphin Milk test scenarios. Extends the single-agent pattern from tests/integration/scenarios.json to support multiple agents, sequenced steps, and cross-agent assertions.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Must be '2.0' for multi-worm scenarios.

default_timeout_seconds.description: Default per-scenario timeout in seconds. Overridden by scenario-level timeout_seconds.

tier.description: Test tier. canary=health checks, basic=simple cross-agent, security=injection/adversarial, economic=payment flows, full=complete protocol roundtrips.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this scenario tests.

agents.description: Agent names used in this scenario. Must match names in config.json.

steps.description: Ordered list of test steps executed sequentially.

assertions.description: Post-scenario assertions evaluated after all steps complete.

skip.description: Skip this scenario when running the suite.

agent.description: Which agent performs this step. Must be listed in the scenario's agents array.

action.description: Step action type. task=submit a task (POST /task), wait=wait for an event, assert=check a condition, api=direct HTTP call.

message.description: Task message or content. Supports {{agent.field}} template variables. Required for 'task' action.

max_cost_sats.description: Maximum satoshis this step may spend.

max_iterations.description: Maximum agent loop iterations for task steps.

event.description: Event to wait for. Required for 'wait' action.

path.description: API path for 'api' action (e.g. '/health', '/agent', '/task/{{task_id}}/events'). Supports {{template}} variables.

body.description: Request body for 'api' action with POST/PUT.

store_as.description: Store the result of this step under this key for use in later steps via {{store_as_key}} template variables.

agent.description: Which agent's response to check (if applicable).

step.description: Reference to a step index or store_as key whose result to check.

value.description: Expected value. Type depends on assertion type: string for contains/matches, integer for status_code/cost_within, object for field_equals.

field.description: JSON field path for field_equals/field_exists assertions (e.g. 'identity_key', 'status').

tool_name.description: Tool name for tool_succeeded and tool_result_contains assertions.

max_total_sats.description: Maximum total satoshis across all agents for this scenario.

max_per_agent_sats.description: Maximum satoshis any single agent may spend.
